name: ceda
description: Claude Code plugins by CEDA: an AI software factory that runs support and development tickets end to end, with a human validation queue.

plugins.name: ai-factory
plugins.description: Onboards a project (repos, stack, ticketing, forge, chat, environments), then runs tickets through a frame → code → review → test → ship chain and two pilots (support, dev) that loop on their own and queue every outward action for approval.
